detail.longDescription: Linux desktop usage in North America reached 10.65% in Statcounter’s July 2026 data, entering double digits for the first time. 📈 Cloudflare data also shows a strong Linux presence, though both datasets measure web activity rather than installed systems. 🐧 🔗 https:// linuxiac.com/linux-desktop-mar ket-share-surpasses-10-in-north-america/ # TechNews # Linux # OpenSource # LinuxDesktop # Statcounter # Cloudflare # FOSS # Privacy # Security # Software # Technology # Desktop # Computing
